meta.title: How It Works
meta.description: How Yuanfen works: tell us what you need, we match you with a local guide or partner, we assist you, and you are taken care of.

howItWorks.h1: From your first message to a trip well taken care of
howItWorks.intro: Four steps. You choose the service, we handle the rest.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.text: Fill in the short form for your service or message us on WhatsApp. Tell us what you want and when.

steps.title: We match you with a local guide or partner
steps.text: We look for the right person in China for your plan and check the details with you.

steps.title: We assist you
steps.text: You get a clear quote. Once you are happy, we prepare everything and stay in touch before and during your trip.

steps.title: You're taken care of
steps.text: Enjoy your trip or process. If plans change, we are a message away.

howItWorks.noPricesText: We do not list fixed prices because every request is different. Fill in the form and we will send you a quote. Requesting a quote is free and carries no obligation.

meta.title: Request a Destination
meta.description: Destination not listed? Tell us where you want to go and we will check if we can find a guide.

requestDestination.intro: Tell us the place you want to visit. We'll check if we can find a guide, or run a quick survey first.
requestDestination.formTitle: Where would you like to go?

meta.title: Partnership for Companies
meta.description: Partner with Yuanfen: travel agencies, hospitals and clinics, universities and education agents, suppliers and merchants.

partnership.intro: We build a network of trusted partners in China and abroad. If your company would like to work with us, tell us about it.

agency.title: Travel agencies
agency.text: Send your clients to trusted local guides, or add China ground support to your packages.

hospital.title: Hospitals & clinics
hospital.text: Reach international patients with interpreter-supported appointments.

university.title: Universities & education agents
university.text: Connect with students who are looking for a place to study in China.

supplier.title: Suppliers & merchants
supplier.text: Supply goods and services to our shopping and travel clients.

partnership.formIntro: Share a few details and our team will get back to you.

meta.title: Become a Guide
meta.description: Apply to guide travelers with Yuanfen in China. Students are welcome.

becomeGuide.intro: Do you live in China and enjoy showing people around? Tell us about yourself. Students are welcome.
why: Lives in a Chinese city and knows it well
Speaks English, Indonesian, or another language travelers use
Friendly, reliable and good at explaining
Experience is helpful, but not required
becomeGuide.formIntro: A few quick questions about you.

meta.title: About & FAQ
meta.description: About Yuanfen, the meaning of 缘分, and answers to common questions about our services.

about.lead: Yuanfen is your bridge to China, guided by fate.
about.meaningText: 缘分 is the Chinese idea of fate bringing people, or things, together. It is our spirit: connecting you with China, its people and its opportunities.
about.ribbonText: The red ribbon in our logo recalls the red thread of fate in Chinese culture, said to bind people who are destined to meet.
about.storyText: Yuanfen is made in Guangzhou. This is where the full story of the team and how Yuanfen started will go.
about.baseText: We work with local guides and partners in China, and we speak with you in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
about._PLACEHOLDER: About story text is a draft placeholder; the owner must write the real story.

contact.intro: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. You can also email us or use the form.
contact.formIntro: Prefer a form? Leave your details and we will reply.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Yuanfen collects, uses and protects your personal information.

privacy.draftNote: This is a draft for owner and legal review. It is not final legal advice.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: Yuanfen ("we") runs this website and connects clients with local guides and partners in China.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you send a form, we collect the details you type in: your name, how to contact you, and what you need. We do not ask for passport numbers, payment details or medical records through this website, and you should not send them.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: We use your details to reply to your request, prepare a quote, match you with a guide or partner, and improve our service.

sections.title: Who sees it
sections.text: Our team, and the guides or partners we need to involve to fulfil your request. Our website and database providers process data on our behalf. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: PLACEHOLDER: retention period to be confirmed by the owner.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete your information by contacting us.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: We use a cookie to remember your language choice. We do not use advertising cookies.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: Questions about this policy? Use the contact page.

confirmation.h1: Thank you, we have your request
confirmation.text: Our team will contact you within {time}.

confirmation.noRef: We could not find a reference code. If you just sent a request, please contact us on WhatsApp.

meta.title: Service Inquiry Form
meta.description: Tell us what you need in China: guides, transport, business and medical assistance, translation, shopping or school visits. Free quotation, no obligation.

inquiry.h1: Tell us what you need in China
inquiry.greeting: Hi! Thank you for contacting Yuanfen.
inquiry.intro: To help us understand your needs and give you an accurate quotation, please fill in the details below. It takes about five minutes.
inquiry.note: Please note: the final quotation will depend on your destination, dates, number of people and the specific services you need.
inquiry.afterSubmit: Once we receive your details, our team will review your request and send you a suitable quotation.
inquiry.closing: Thank you for choosing Yuanfen. Connecting Indonesia × China.
